chapterInfo.content:
58
Onyamesom huhuo
1 # Mika 3.8 Team denden, nnodo ho;
ma wo nne so sɛ totorobɛnto,
na ka me man mmarato ne Yakob fie bɔne kyerɛ wɔn.
2 # Yes 43.26 Ɛwom, wɔhwehwɛ me da biara,
na wɔpɛ sɛ wɔhunu m’akwan,
sɛ gyama wɔyɛ ɔman bi a wɔdi asɛntenenee
na wɔnnyaa wɔn Nyankopɔn ahyɛdeɛ no;
wɔbisa me hɔ asɛntenenee,
wɔpɛ sɛ wɔpinkyɛ Onyankopɔn.
3Wɔka sɛ: Adɛn nti na yɛdi mmuada na wonhunu,
yɛbrɛ yɛn kra ase na wonnim yi?
Hwɛ, mo abuada da no,
moyɛ deɛ mo ara mopɛ,
na moteetee mo adwumayɛfoɔ nyinaa.
4Hwɛ, ɔham ne ntɔkwa mu na mode di mmuada,
na mobɔ kuturuku atirimuɔden so.
Ɛnyɛ mo nnɛ yi mmuada yi na ɛbɛma wɔate mo nne wɔ soro.
5 # Sak 7.5; Mat 6.16-18 Sɛdeɛ mmuada a mɛpɛ no
ɛda a onipa brɛ ne kra ase no teɛ nie?
Sɛ obi si ne tiri ase sɛ mmɛwa
na ɔsɛ ayitoma ne nso da so a,
yei na wofrɛ no abuadadie
ne da a ɛsɔ AWURADE ani yi anaa?
Mmɔborɔhunu na ɛsɔ Nyankopɔn ani
6Ɛnyɛ yei ne abuadadie a mepɛ?
Sɛ mobɛsanesane abɔnefoɔ apɔ,
ahotiri kɔnnua nhoma,
ama wɔn a wɔhom wɔn soɔ no afa wɔn ho akɔdie,
na moabubu kɔnnua nyinaa?
7 # Mat 25.35 Ɛnyɛ yei nso: Sɛ wobubu wo paanoo ma deɛ ɛkɔm de no di bi,
na wode mmɔborɔfoɔ, adamfikyi, ba wo fie,
sɛ wohunu dagyani a, wokata ne ho,
na womfa wo ho nhunta wo honam mu nnipa?
8 # Yes 58.10; Dwom 37.6 Ɛno na wo hann bɛpue sɛ adekyeeɛ,
na w’akwahosan afefɛ ntɛm.
Wo tenenee bɛdi w’anim,
na AWURADE animuonyam abɔ wo kyidɔm.
9 # Yes 30.19 Ɛno na wobɛfrɛ, na AWURADE bɛbua,
wobɛteam, na ɔbɛka sɛ: Menie.
Sɛ woyi kɔnnua firi wo mu,
nsateaa tene ne ahuhukasa,
10na wode deɛ wo kra pɛ ma deɛ ɛkɔm de no,
na woma ɔkra a ɔyɛ mmɔborɔ no mee a,
ɛno deɛ wo hann bɛpue sum mu,
na wo kusuu bɛyɛ sɛ awia ketee.
11 # Yer 31.12 Na AWURADE bɛkyerɛ wo kwan daa nyinaa,
na ɔde nnepa amee wo kra,
na wahyɛ wo nnompe mu den,
na woayɛ sɛ turo a nsuo sene wɔ mu ne nsuo aniwa a emu nsuo nni hwammɔ.
12 # Yes 61.4 Na wo mufoɔ bɛkyekyere tete akurofo,
wobɛma awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ ahodoɔ fapem agyina,
na wɔafrɛ wo ɔpamago,
deɛ ɔtoto akwan sɛ nnipa ntena hɔ.
Homedadie pa so nhyira
13 # Yes 56.2, 4 Sɛ wosianka wo nan homeda
na me da kronkron no woanyɛ deɛ wo pɛ,
na wofrɛ me homeda sɛ anigyedeɛ,
ne AWURADE da kronkron no sɛ da a ɛsɛ anidie,
na wodi no ni na woamfa wo ara w’akwan so,
na woanyɛ deɛ wo ara wo pɛ, na woankeka nsɛm hunu a,
14ɛnna w’ani bɛgye AWURADE ho,
na mɛma woafa asase so sorɔnsorɔnbea so,
na mɛma woadi w’agya Yakob agyapadeɛ no,
ɛfiri sɛ AWURADE ano na aka.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
